page.layout: One page: the front cover of a bound volume, a blind-tooled leather board with two metal clasps on the right edge. A library stamp in the centre (Zentralbibliothek Zürich) is the only printed element; it is not transcribed.
page.notes: Front board of the binding, not a printed page. No text of the book is present. The round stamp reading "ZENTRALBIBLIOTHEK ZÜRICH" with a coat of arms is a library stamp and is left out as page furniture. Blind-tooled decorative border visible on the leather.
